note: Generated by art/slice_pack2.py. Worn-proof crops (NOT shipped) for registering hair and open-shoe sprites to the head / feet they were painted on. proof_box = [x, y, w, h] of the crop in the worn sheet; offset = top-left of the item sprite (dist/assets/pack2/<file>) inside the proof crop, measured by masked RGB template matching of the sprite against the worn sheet (the two sheets are separate generations). registration.shift_vs_sprite_box = how far the item sits on the worn sheet from where it sits on the item sheet (hair is matched on its top 40%, the scalp, so the hairline sits right even where lengths were redrawn); band_offsets = best extra shift of the top/middle/bottom third alone, counted only if it lowers that band's error by >10% (residual misalignment); identical_px = fraction of the sprite's opaque pixels identical to the proof at the offset (the item sheets are mostly cut-outs of the worn sheets; low values = redrawn); iou = overlap of the sprite with the proof pixels classified as the item; proof_item_uncovered = fraction of those proof pixels the sprite does not cover. Shoe pairs also list per-part offsets.
